Subject: Vendor onboarding refresh — questions about portal fields and evidence flow

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks again for the renewal call yesterday — excited to lock in the 12-month term and the capacity uplift. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items before they run the PO through our system:

- Can you confirm which procurement portal fields we need to populate to avoid manual review? (e.g., vendor type, SLA tier, billing cadence)
- For evidence upload: does Redwood support an SFTP drop or do we need to use the portal UI only?
- Do you have a sample PO template (format) so our systems can pre-validate before submission?

We have an internal cutover on 7/31 for vendor attestations — would love to finish the onboarding gating by COB 7/27 if possible.

Thanks,
Erin Walsh

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh — questions about portal fields and evidence flow

Hi Erin — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and a proposed onboarding checkpoint plan.

1) Procurement portal fields: we’ve attached a field mapping CSV (procure-portal-field-mapping.csv) with the minimal set that clears our automated gate: vendor type, tax id, primary contact, billing cadence (monthly/annual), SLA tier, billing account id. If AcmeCo can pre-populate those, your PO should skip manual review in most cases.

2) Evidence upload: we support both portal UI uploads and an SFTP ingestion for bulk evidence. For SFTP you’ll need a one-time credential exchange (we issue a short-lived key and a dedicated drop path).

3) PO template: attached sample PO (PO-sample_acmeco.pdf) and I’ve included a small checklist for procurement to self-validate before upload.

Proposed timeline (to hit your 7/27 gating request):
- Today (7/20): send field CSV + PO sample (attached) — action: Acme to populate fields
- 7/22: Redwood Sales Ops validates the pre-filled file and confirms if any manual review is required
- 7/24: DocuSign send for signature (if terms change to 12m, we’ll use amendment template)
- 7/25–7/26: evidence SFTP test (if chosen) + final PO submission

I’ve attached the onboarding checklist (redwood_onboarding-checklist.xlsx). Marissa / Stephanie — can you take point on Sales Ops validation and DocuSign template? Karthik, loop in Legal if the amendment needs a clause tweak for the capacity ramp.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onboarding-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), procure-portal-field-mapping.csv (text/csv), PO-sample_acmeco.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh — questions about portal fields and evidence flow

Erin — looped Stephanie (Sales Ops) and Laura (Customer Ops) to help with the validations and the SFTP credentials. A few notes from my side:

- If AcmeCo chooses SFTP, we recommend a single daily drop (zip) with a manifest.csv; that gets processed by our evidence pipeline and attached to the customer record. That avoids manual uploads per document.
- For faster processing, set billing cadence to "annual" and include the PO number in the manifest header — our parser flags missing PO numbers as manual review.
- If you want to avoid a contract amendment workflow, we can include the capacity uplift as an addendum in the DocuSign template. Diego — I flagged the Karthik touchpoint for the ramp schedule.

Quick ask for AcmeCo: can you confirm whether finance requires the vendor address on the first page of the PO? Some EMEA finance teams insist on it; it can trip the pre-validation.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
